races.paceDynamic: The Liffey, Dontspoilasale, Thaloria and Suerte all want prominent positions in an 8-runner field, creating inevitable traffic problems and a false pace scenario. With no genuine front-runner, these four will jostle for position early before the pace inevitably quickens, setting up the hold-up horses Una Matata, Benavente, Ruff Justice and Crest Of Light for late charges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners crowd each other and get shuffled back 2-3 furlongs out
scenarios.body: The pace collapses as they interfere with each other, allowing the cleaner-travelling hold-up horses to sweep past. Una Matata and Benavente benefit most from the sustained gallop.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: The Liffey Breaks Clear
scenarios.trigger: If The Liffey can secure an uncontested lead from the prominent pack
scenarios.body: His superior rating tells as he kicks clear of the false pace, with the hold-up horses unable to close the gap despite late efforts. Dontspoilasale stays on best of the rest.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Blitz
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet go too fast early and collapse collectively
scenarios.body: The sustained pace suits the patient tactics perfectly as all four hold-up runners arrive together. Crest Of Light and Una Matata have the best late kicks in this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Suerte Springs Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Suerte can avoid the early scrimmaging and gets a dream run through
scenarios.body: The lowest-rated horse benefits from a perfectly-judged ride as the others cancel each other out. Thaloria provides the main danger if also avoiding trouble.

Monitor how Benavente and Ruff Justice handle today's good going as both are marked going-dependent.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Going Deteriorates Mid-Race
scenarios.trigger: If rain arrives during racing and affects the surface significantly
scenarios.body: Nikki Swango's going dependency becomes a major factor as others struggle with changing conditions. The hold-up horses may find improved ground to make their moves on the fresh surface.

scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and creates maximum chaos
scenarios.body: A pedestrian gallop turns into a complete lottery where positioning trumps ability. An unfancied hold-up horse with the right trip emerges from the pack.

races.paceDynamic: With all five higher-rated runners carrying unknown pace styles and only Lamar River showing hold-up tendencies, this maiden lacks a natural pace-setter. The debutants Maria Quiteria, Arrowstock, Whammy, Belle Island and Brazilian Diva will likely jostle for early position without sustained pressure, creating a falsely-run affair. Expect a bunched field turning for home with the sprint finish suiting whoever handles the tactical nature best.

scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely modest with gentle fractions
scenarios.body: Lamar River's hold-up style becomes an advantage as the field crawls along early. The sprint finish plays to experienced runners who know how to quicken when it matters.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If one newcomer shows natural pace and takes them along
scenarios.body: Brazilian Diva or Whammy could surprise by setting honest fractions that suit their unknown stamina reserves. The sustained pace eliminates kick-reliant types and rewards the most forward-going.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If multiple debutants refuse to commit early creating stop-start fractions
scenarios.body: The race becomes a tactical nightmare with false pace throughout the opening half-mile. Raw ability trumps race-craft as the field sprints from the 2f pole in a lottery finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Experience Beats Youth
scenarios.trigger: If Lamar River's racecourse knowledge proves decisive despite lower rating
scenarios.body: The hold-up specialist times his run perfectly while the debutants make positional errors. Proven race-sense outweighs raw talent in a tightly-contested finish.
